features.name: carat
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: diamond weight in carats.

features.name: cut
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: cut quality category, originally ranging from Fair through Ideal. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: color
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: diamond color grade, originally from D as best to J as worst. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: clarity
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: clarity grade, originally categories such as I1, SI, VS, VVS, and IF. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: depth
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: total depth percentage, defined from the diamond depth relative to its average diameter.

features.name: table
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: table percentage, the width of the top facet relative to the widest point of the diamond.

features.name: x
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: diamond length in millimeters.

features.name: y
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: diamond width in millimeters.

features.name: z
features.description: Diamonds dataset variable: diamond depth in millimeters.

features.name: price
features.description: Prediction target for the diamonds task: diamond price in US dollars. The CAIM preprocessing moves price to the final column.
